sections.title: Overview
sections.content: JSONChunking preserves object and array hierarchy while keeping serialized output inside a byte budget. This property is intentionally long enough to compete with sibling properties for space in the same chunk.

sections.title: Mixed characters
sections.content: This field intentionally mixes 中文、English words、日本語、한글、العربية, emoji 🤖🔍✅, and the combining-character form café to compare serialized bytes with Unicode runes.

sections.title: Nested values
sections.content: Deeply nested values exercise the recursive object traversal used by JSONChunking.

sections.title: A property larger than a tiny budget
sections.content: This deliberately long property contains several sentences. A tiny byte budget may not be able to preserve it together with its surrounding object. The strategy must choose a deterministic representation and must never emit invalid JSON. Repeated observations should produce the same ordering and the same chunk boundaries for the same input. The test phrase 中文内容 uses multiple UTF-8 bytes, so equal visible-character counts do not imply equal serialized-byte sizes. The tail of this property is retained so the viewer can show whether any content disappears during recursive splitting.
